title: Set up a passkey for your Meridian account
summary: Replace text message codes with a passkey on your laptop or phone. Required by October 31.
body:
1. Go to the account security page from the quick links.
  2. Choose Add a passkey.
  3. Confirm with your fingerprint, face or laptop PIN.
  4. Sign out and back in to test it.

No company phone? Collect a security key from the service desk or the Tulsa IT cage.

title: Reset your password
summary: Forgot your password or locked out? Reset it yourself in a few minutes.
body:
1. On the sign-in page, choose Forgot password?
  2. Enter your Meridian email address.
  3. Follow the link in the email within 30 minutes.

Still locked out? Call the service desk on extension 4357.

title: Connect to the VPN
summary: You need the VPN for the ERP, file shares and the plant systems when you are away from the office.
body:
1. Open the Meridian VPN app from the menu bar.
  2. Sign in with your Meridian account and passkey.
  3. Pick the nearest location: Austin, Tulsa or Rotterdam.

If the VPN is slow, check the system status page first.

title: Set up email and calendar on your phone
summary: Add your Meridian email and calendar to an iPhone or Android phone.
body:
1. Install the company mail app from your phone's app store.
  2. Sign in with your Meridian email.
  3. Approve the device management prompt.

title: Request new software
summary: How to get software that is not on your laptop yet, and what is already approved.
body:
Most approved software is in the Software Center app on your laptop. Install it from there with one click.

For anything else, open a request with the service desk. Security reviews new tools within five working days.

title: Report a phishing email
summary: Use the Report button in your mail app. It takes one click and protects everyone.
body:
1. Do not click links or open attachments.
  2. Select the email and choose Report in the toolbar.
  3. Delete it.

Clicked by mistake? Call the service desk straight away. You will not be in trouble.

title: Book a meeting room
summary: Book rooms in Austin, Denver and Rotterdam from your calendar.
body: Add a room to any calendar invite with the Rooms button. Video rooms are marked with a camera icon. During the Austin 4th floor refresh, use the 3rd floor rooms.

title: Print from your laptop
summary: Add the office printers and release your print job with your badge.
body:
1. Open Software Center and install Meridian Print.
  2. Print as normal and pick Meridian-Secure.
  3. Tap your badge on any printer to release the job.

title: Get a replacement laptop
summary: Laptops are replaced every four years, or sooner if they are broken.
body: Laptops are replaced every four years. If yours is older, or broken, open a request with the service desk. Your files sync to the cloud, so setup takes about 30 minutes.

title: Join the Wi-Fi at the plant
summary: Connect to Meridian-Plant on the Tulsa floor and in the offices.
body: Choose Meridian-Plant and sign in with your Meridian account. Guests use Meridian-Guest with the code from reception. Some areas of the line have no Wi-Fi on purpose.
